OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

## Summary

I implemented required-field validation for owner creation (`POST /api/owners`) so that a missing or blank `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone` is rejected with **400** and a JSON body whose `errors` array names each offending field.

The endpoint's request body already carries Bean Validation constraints (generated from the OpenAPI spec: `@NotNull`, `@Size(min=1)`, `@Pattern`). Two gaps existed: the 400 response didn't expose an `errors` array, and whitespace-only values (e.g. `"   "` for `address`/`city`) slipped past `@Size(min=1)`. I closed both:

**`ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`**
- `handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` now adds an `errors` property listing the distinct field names that failed validation — so `@NotNull`/`@Pattern`/`@Size` violations (missing field, bad telephone) surface at `$.errors`.
- Added `handleMissingOwnerFieldsException` returning 400 with the same `errors` shape.

**`MissingOwnerFieldsException.java`** (new) — carries the list of missing/blank field names.

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — added `rejectMissingOrBlankFields(...)`, which treats null-or-whitespace as invalid (`String.isBlank()`) for all five fields and throws the exception. This is what catches whitespace-only `address`/`city` that Bean Validation's `@Size(min=1)` treats as present.

Both validation paths produce the same `{ "errors": [ ...field names... ] }` body. The three acceptance tests (`errorRejectsMissingCity`, `errorRejectsBlankTelephone`, `functionalityAcceptsCompleteOwner`) pass, and the full suite is green.
